aggressive_definition_excerpt: There were no significant differences in the association of plasma selenium with risk when analyzed by stage or grade of disease.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The association between plasma selenium concentration and prostate cancer risk was assessed in 959 men with incident prostate cancer and 1059 matched controls.
reason: The abstract reports overall incident prostate cancer risk. Generic analyses by stage or grade do not establish an explicit advanced, high-grade, aggressive, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Overall, plasma selenium concentration was not associated with prostate cancer risk; the multivariate relative risk for men in the highest fifth of selenium concentration compared with the lowest fifth was 0.96 (95% CI: 0.70, 1.31; P for trend = 0.25).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is explicitly the overall prostate cancer estimate; it is not an estimate for an aggressive stratum.
